basis: workflow/q3_inputs_v5.json numerical and the existing review_q3_complete CSV comparator; unchanged bounds.
scope: Decoded scientific CSV/JSON/gzip outputs including projects, selections and embedded hashes. Each run first passes its own raw SHA, latest-attempt, code/input and admission verification.
exact: JSON types/integers/booleans/strings, keys/list order, discrete decisions and parameter identities; no embedded hash exclusions.
excluded: Run receipts, timing, logs, source snapshots, plots, prose reports and gaps; their original bytes remain covered by each run integrity check.
